tables: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_dictionary (sensor_int_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, sensor_str_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS synapse_sensor_telemetry_raw (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, collected_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), scenario_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', sensor_str_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sensor_int_id INTEGER, flow_rate REAL, speed REAL, occupancy REAL, sample_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1, status SMALLINT DEFAULT 2);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS synapse_sensor_hourly_summary (sensor_int_id INTEGER NOT NULL, summary_hour TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, scenario_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', sample_count INTEGER NOT NULL, avg_speed REAL NOT NULL, min_speed REAL NOT NULL, avg_flow REAL NOT NULL, avg_occupancy REAL NOT NULL, total_volume REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sensor_int_id, summary_hour, scenario_name));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS synapse_golden_history (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, version VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'v1', sensor_str_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, sensor_int_id INTEGER, timestamp_val TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, flow_rate REAL NOT NULL, speed REAL NOT NULL, occupancy REAL NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cloud_file_vault (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, filename TEXT NOT NULL, relative_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, file_content BYTEA, last_updated TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_physics_episodes (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), sensor_str_id VARCHAR(255), sensor_int_id INTEGER, anomaly_score REAL NOT NULL, physics_residual REAL NOT NULL, state_vector JSONB, xai_verdict TEXT, metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS operation_sessions (session_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, start_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, end_time TIMESTAMP, status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'EM_OPERACAO', error_message TEXT);
